scope: Past Written Papers (PP) series retrieval index. One entry per paper and one per question. This file is an INDEX, not a content source: answer text lives only in the paper spec. Regenerate with build_index.py; never hand-edit.
naming_convention: QP<YY><MM>.html, where QP = Question Paper, YY = year and MM = month of the sitting (QP2607 = July 2026); question_id QP<YY><MM>-Q<n>; anchors #q1..#q9
source_of_truth_policy: specs/<PAPER>.json is authoritative for content. This manifest is authoritative for retrieval. Both index pages and the paper page are generated; editing generated HTML is always wrong.

recurrence_classes.new: No prior sitting recorded on the source paper.
recurrence_classes.topic_recurrence: Prior sittings recorded for the same topic; wording NOT compared.
recurrence_classes.near_recurrence: Wording compared and substantially similar, with a recorded delta.

recurrence_rule: A third-party recurrence table alone only supports topic_recurrence. near_ and exact_ require the prior paper wording to have been compared.

paper_status_model.available: Answers are published for this sitting.
paper_status_model.coming_later: No answers yet. Covers every case a student cannot act on -- not transcribed, in production, or source copy held only. Holding a source copy never reads as solved.

questions.question_text: Reducing the speed of main propulsion engines is considered to be the simplest and most practical short-term solution for lowering GHG emissions from ships. What are the drawbacks and dangers of operating main propulsion two stroke marine engines at low speeds for extended periods of time? How can these issues be resolved and the risks associated with low speed operation reduced?
questions.verification_status: Regulatory framing verified against IMO primary sources; engine behaviour rests on established marine-engineering principle and engine-designer service guidance, recorded as such

reverify_before_publication.claim: The IMO Net-Zero Framework is approved but not adopted, following adjournment of the October 2025 extraordinary MEPC session
reverify_before_publication.why: The adjourned session was due to reconvene approximately twelve months later, i.e. around October 2026. If it has since adopted the Framework, the currency section of the study guide must be updated - although the January 2026 statement itself remains correct for the question date.

reverify_before_publication.claim: Low-load engine behaviour and remedies are stated generically rather than to one engine designer's figures
reverify_before_publication.why: MIW holds no licensed engine-designer service letter set. The engineering is standard principle plus publicly available guidance, and load bands and cylinder oil recommendations are deliberately given as approximate. Ships must follow their own maker documentation.
